definitions.short: properly, to prostrate ; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear
definitions.usage: abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.
